mapper.sql: p.*, s.name AS store_name, fw.name AS from_warehouse_name, tw.name AS to_warehouse_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(it.sku_qty) FROM ecom_inbound_item it JOIN ecom_inbound i ON i.id = it.inbound_id WHERE i.plan_id = p.id AND i.status <> 'CANCELLED' AND it.part_main = 1), 0) AS shipped_qty

FROM ecom_shipment_plan p JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = p.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse fw ON fw.id = p.from_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse tw ON tw.id = p.to_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = p.create_by
